security.title: Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
security.summary: Barracuda has disclosed details of two vulnerabilities affecting its products that, if chained together, could allow an attacker to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to a susceptible device. security.title: cPGuard Update Channel Hijacked to Backdoor Linux Servers and Collect Password Hashes
security.summary: An attacker broke into the update system of the cPGuard security tool on November 2 and used it to send a malicious script to customers' Linux servers. The script installed a backdoor and collected password hashes and other sensitive files from servers that ran it, cPGuard maker OPSSHIELD said in an advisory.
